title: An M5 overextension above an M15 uptrend
why: Rule 2 through MCD2's branch (an M5 uptrend stretched above its corridor): a SHORT against the spike for both trader types, while M15 is still an ordinary uptrend. MCD3 is consolidated up, against the SHORT, so it adds a note and no caution; both readings are VALID. The price is above the whole M5 channel, so a SHORT has nothing above it to make a zone from (NO_ZONE_SOURCES).
